name: arma-fleet-hub
description: Fleet Hub — Arma-Hire native mobile shell (Capacitor) wrapping the existing web app.

scripts.prepare:www: cp -f index.html fleet.css data.js mobile-native.css mobile-native.js www/
scripts.sync: npm run prepare:www && npx cap sync
scripts.android:open: npm run sync && npx cap open android
scripts.android:run: npm run sync && npx cap run android
scripts.android:apk: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug && echo 'APK: android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk'
scripts.ios:open: npm run sync && npx cap open ios
scripts.ios:run: npm run sync && npx cap run ios
